documentation.content:
One or more ERROR-severity lines were logged by the CairoAI API.

Every unhandled exception is logged by app.py's exception handler as a single structured line carrying `error_type` and `stack_trace`. To see what broke:

  gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND severity>=ERROR' --limit=20 --project cairoai --format='value(jsonPayload.error_type, jsonPayload.endpoint, jsonPayload.message)'

Group by jsonPayload.error_type to tell one repeated fault from several different ones.

Before this existed, errors reached nothing: the only log handler wrote to /tmp/logs/api.log, which is per-instance and wiped on cold start, and Python's last-resort stderr handler never fired because that handler had already taken the record. A TypeError in the prediction path survived in production until it happened to be narrated on screen.
